Before you buy

Before ordering, check that the gift works with their setup and fits the space they have.

Ask which gaming system they use, what they already own, or which book edition they collect.

Read the gift buying guide

Photo: Katya Azimova / Unsplash

A few things to check before buying

Think about what they already use and what they’ve mentioned wanting. A worn-out controller, a favorite book series, or a recipe they keep meaning to try can give you a place to start.

Check the fit

A controller needs to work with their gaming system. A book should match the edition they collect. A desk accessory needs room on their desk. Ask about these details if you’re unsure.

Include the extras

Allow for shipping, tax, and any supplies the gift needs. Print the photo for a frame, fill in an appreciation book, and check whether batteries or cables are included.

Look over your matches

Each quiz result includes a shopping link and a “Check before buying” section. Some links open a product; others open an Amazon search. Check the price, delivery date, and returns before ordering.
